MALVERN, Pa., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Annovis Bio, Inc. (NYSE: ANVS) (“Annovis” or the “Company”), a Phase 3 clinical-stage biotechnology company developing buntanetap, an investigational once-daily pill for neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and Parkinson’s disease (PD), today announced that on November 25, 2026, it received written notice from the New York Stock Exchange (the "NYSE"). The notice states that the Company is not in compliance with Section 802.01C of the NYSE Listed Company Manual. That section requires the average closing price of a listed company's common stock to be at least $1.00 per share over a consecutive 30 trading-day period. As of November 24, 2026, the 30 trading-day average closing price of the Company's common stock was $0.93.

The Company has six months after receiving the notice to regain compliance with the minimum share price requirement. During that time, the Company's common stock will continue to be listed and traded on the NYSE under the symbol "ANVS," with a ".BC" indicator showing that the Company is below the NYSE's continued listing standards. The Company will regain compliance if on the last trading day of any calendar month during the cure period its closing share price is at least $1.00 and its average closing share price over the 30 trading days ending that day is also at least $1.00.

The Company intends to notify the NYSE within the required 10 business days of its intent to cure the deficiency. The Company intends to monitor the closing price of its common stock and to consider all available options to regain compliance, which may include a reverse stock split, subject to stockholder approval.

As previously disclosed, on October 29, 2026, the Company received a separate notice from the NYSE because its average global market capitalization over a consecutive 30 trading-day period was below $50 million and, at the same time, its stockholders' equity was below $50 million. The Company remains subject to the conditions in that notice. The cure periods under the two standards run independently of each other.

The NYSE notice does not immediately affect the listing or trading of the Company's common stock. The notice also does not affect the Company's business operations or its reporting obligations with the Securities and Exchange Commission, and it does not conflict with or cause an event of default under any of the Company's material debt or other agreements.

About Annovis
Headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, Annovis Bio, Inc. (NYSE: ANVS) is a Phase 3 clinical-stage biotechnology company developing treatments for neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Parkinson's disease (PD). The Company's lead drug candidate, buntanetap (formerly posiphen), is an investigational once-daily oral therapy that inhibits the translation of multiple neurotoxic proteins, including APP and amyloid beta, tau, alpha-synuclein, and TDP-43, through a specific RNA-targeting mechanism of action. By addressing the underlying causes of neurodegeneration, Annovis aims to halt disease progression and improve cognitive and motor functions in patients. For more information, visit www.annovisbio.com and follow us on LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.

SINGAPORE, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Phaos Technology Holdings (Cayman) Limited (NYSE American: POAS) ("Phaos" or the "Company") today outlined an opportunity to develop automated car wash and vehicle care services in Southeast Asia, particularly in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand. The Company is evaluating Singapore and Malaysia as initial markets for services that combine convenience for drivers and fleet operators with automation and water reuse. In a second phase, it may consider expanding into other Southeast Asian markets.

Singapore had more than 650,000 cars in October 2026, including nearly 99,000 private-hire cars, according to Land Transport Authority data1. In Malaysia, the Malaysian Automotive Association2 reported 630,461 new passenger vehicles sold from January through October 2026, up about 4% year over year. Separately, Grand View Research3 estimates that Malaysia's broader car wash services market could grow from US$208.9 million in 2025 to US$361.7 million by 2033, a projected annual growth rate of 7.3% from 2026 to 2033. The forecast covers multiple wash formats and does not estimate revenue for Phaos.

In Indonesia, Ken Research4 estimates that paid professional car wash services could grow from US$390 million in 2025 to US$686 million in 2032, or 8.4% annually. In Thailand, a nationwide National Statistical Office survey5 put 2023 receipts for businesses classified under car washing, polishing and similar services at THB 14.1 billion. In October 2026, Bangchak6 reported Lodon JetX automated washes at 50 of its fuel stations, showing adoption of the format. The two market figures cover broader service categories and do not measure Phaos's addressable revenue.

Phaos is exploring the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to automate car washing, with the aim of reducing labor costs and improving water recycling. In Singapore, Inchcape reported that the automated gantry it developed with Kärcher can recycle up to 85% of the water used per wash.7

"We see an opportunity to serve vehicles that need regular care," said Gan Hong Loon, Chief Executive Officer of Phaos. "Singapore and specific regions in Malaysia give us places to test demand and site economics before we consider expanding."

Headquartered in Singapore, Phaos has its roots in advanced microscopy and is pursuing a strategic repositioning toward engineering, procurement and construction (EPC). For more information, visit the company website.8

GIG HARBOR, WA / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / IP Strategy Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq:IPST) (the "Company" or "IP Strategy") today announced that it received a notification letter from The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq") dated November 24, 2026, advising the Company that, because it has not yet filed its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the period ended September 30, 2026 (the "Form 10-Q"), the Company is not currently in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1).

Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) requires listed companies to timely file all required periodic financial reports with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

The Nasdaq notification has no immediate effect on the listing of the Company's common stock on Nasdaq. However, if the Company fails to timely regain compliance with the Listing Rule 5250(c)(1), the Company's common stock will be subject to delisting from Nasdaq.

Under the Nasdaq Listing Rules, the Company has 60 calendar days from the date of the notification, or until January 23, 2027, to submit to Nasdaq a plan to regain compliance. If Nasdaq accepts the Company's plan, Nasdaq may grant the Company an exception of up to 180 calendar days from the original due date of the Form 10-Q, or until May 24, 2027, to regain compliance. If Nasdaq does not accept the Company's plan, then the Company will have the opportunity to appeal that decision to a Nasdaq Hearings Panel.

The Company is diligently working to complete and file the Form 10-Q and intends to take the necessary steps to regain compliance with Nasdaq's continued listing requirements in December 2026.

About IP Strategy

IP Strategy Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: IPST) is the first Nasdaq-listed company to hold $DATA tokens, formerly $IP, as a primary treasury reserve asset and operate validator infrastructure for the DATA Network. The Company provides public market investors broad exposure to the AI-native data economy through a regulated equity vehicle. IP Strategy's treasury reserve enables direct participation in the DATA ecosystem, which supports the sourcing, verification, provenance and auditability of real-world data while enabling trusted attribution and commercialization of digital assets and AI training data.

CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Fulcrum Therapeutics, Inc. (“Fulcrum”) (Nasdaq: FULC) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a special cash dividend (the “Pre-Closing Cash Dividend”) in connection with the previously announced merger (the “Merger”) with Slate Medicines, Inc. (“Slate”) pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated August 16, 2026 (the “Merger Agreement”). The Pre-Closing Cash Dividend, which Fulcrum estimates will be an aggregate of up to approximately $275.7 million, or up to an estimated $3.6095 per share, will be payable in cash to holders of record of outstanding shares of Fulcrum common stock as of December 7, 2026. The estimated cash dividend is equal in the aggregate to an amount mutually agreed in good faith by Fulcrum and Slate by reference to the amount by which Fulcrum’s Net Cash (as determined pursuant to the Merger Agreement) is expected to exceed $20,300,000 as of the closing of the Merger. The estimated per share dividend is based on 76,381,948 shares of common stock outstanding as of November 25, 2026. The total actual distribution of the amount of the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend is scheduled to be paid to Fulcrum’s transfer agent on December 10, 2026 (the “Dividend Payment Date”), and may be higher or lower than the estimated amount. The transfer agent will distribute the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend to stockholders within a few days following the Dividend Payment Date.

Payment of the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend is subject to the final determination of Fulcrum’s Net Cash in accordance with the Merger Agreement. The estimated aggregate Pre-Closing Cash Dividend amount includes approximately $7.0 million of proceeds from the sale of Fulcrum’s early-stage fetal hemoglobin (“HbF”) assets to an unaffiliated third-party pharmaceutical company, which are expected to be funded into escrow prior to the closing of the Merger and credited to Fulcrum’s Net Cash for purposes of the Merger Agreement. The closing of the early-stage HbF assets sale is contingent upon consummation of the Merger (or in the event the Merger Agreement is terminated, upon receipt of any necessary approvals). If the anticipated $7.0 million of proceeds are not funded into escrow, the Pre-Closing Cash Dividend will be reduced to an estimated aggregate of $268.7 million, or an estimated $3.5178 per share. Closing of the Merger is expected to occur on or about December 11, 2026, assuming that the transaction is approved by Fulcrum’s stockholders and the satisfaction or waiver of all conditions under the Merger Agreement. Fulcrum’s stockholders will consider and vote upon approval of the Merger at the special meeting of Fulcrum’s stockholders scheduled for 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time on December 3, 2026.

If you need assistance voting your shares or have questions regarding the special meeting of Fulcrum’s stockholders, please contact Fulcrum’s proxy solicitor, D.F. King & Co., Inc., at (800) 431-9643 (toll-free).

SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Trutankless®, Inc. (OTC: TKLS), the Company known for its GEN3-series of smart electric tankless water heaters, today announced that its noteholders have converted approximately $5,000,000 in notes into equity. The conversion eliminates more than $400,000 in annual interest expense on the notes. Additional details are included in a Current Report on Form 8-K that the Company filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on November 24, 2026.

The conversion builds on prior debt-to-equity conversions, including approximately $3 million in April 2024, and continues the Company's plan to strengthen its capital structure while aligning investors with the growth of the brand. For plumbing technicians and wholesale partners, that means a manufacturer with more room to invest in inventory, training and support.

The conversion comes as demand accelerates. The Company reported that net sales for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, rose 146% to a record $1,841,929, compared to $748,491 for the same period in 2025. Third quarter net sales grew 62% year over year to $362,790.

Trutankless® continues to expand its wholesale distribution partner network and contractor relationships nationwide, with particularly strong momentum in Arizona, Texas and Florida. Its 14,000-square-foot North Phoenix facility, opened in October 2025, brings production, engineering, installer training and distribution under one roof. In April, it launched the GEN3 Commercial 208V unit, engineered for condominiums, multi-family housing, salons, restaurants, fitness studios and other light commercial settings.

GEN3+, the next generation of the Trutankless® smart electric tankless water heater, is now in production and shipping. The wireless connected unit works with the Trutankless® connected app for homeowners and the Trutankless® Pro app and Pro dashboard for plumbing professionals, all now in beta. The Company plans to share full GEN3+ details in December.

"This conversion strengthens our balance sheet and lets us put more of our resources behind growth," said Guy Newman, CEO of Trutankless®. "Nine-month sales are up 146%, our distributor and contractor network keeps growing, and our Phoenix facility gives us room to scale. With GEN3+ now shipping and our Pro app and Pro dashboard in beta, we are giving plumbing professionals the tools to support every system they install."

About Trutankless®

Trutankless® is the premier brand in electric tankless water heating. The award-winning brand's GEN3 and GEN3+ lineup delivers endless, on-demand hot water in a sleek, space-saving design for homes, condos, multi-family and light commercial spaces.

The Trutankless® connected app is designed to put performance insights and preventative maintenance alerts in the hands of homeowners and plumbing pros, keeping every system running at peak performance, maximizing energy efficiency and extending its service life.

Trutankless® products are sold through plumbing wholesale distributors and dealers nationwide. Founded in 2008, Trutankless®, Inc. (OTC: TKLS) is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona. Learn more at www.trutankless.com.

BROOKFIELD, NEWS, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Brookfield Renewable Partners L.P. (“BEP”) (NYSE: BEP; TSX: BEP.UN) today announced updates to the plan of arrangement to advance the proposed corporate simplification (the “Simplification”) and declared its quarterly distribution.

In light of the expected benefits of the Simplification to all unitholders and approximately 62% of units voted to date with 99.7% of votes cast in favour, the BEP limited partnership agreement (“LPA”) and plan of arrangement were amended to facilitate completion of the Simplification. 

The amended plan of arrangement now requires approval by two-thirds of votes cast by Unitholders rather than approval by holders of two-thirds of all eligible units. Unitholders will no longer be required to vote on amendments to the BEP LPA and all other substantive terms of the plan of arrangement, including the tax implications and expected benefits for investors, have been retained.

Unitholders who have already submitted a proxy or voting instruction form do not need to vote again.

The deadline for registered unitholders to cast their votes by proxy will now be 5:00 p.m. (Toronto time) on December 7, 2026 with the Unitholders’ Meeting being held virtually on December 9, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. (Toronto time).

The quarterly distribution for BEP will be paid on December 21, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on December 8, 2026, and it is expected that the Simplification will be completed by the end of 2026.

Corporate Simplification Details

Following an amendment to the BEP limited partnership agreement, the Simplification will now be completed pursuant to the terms of an amended plan of arrangement (the “Arrangement”). Upon receipt of approval from BEP unitholders of the Simplification, all outstanding limited partnership units of BEP, other than preferred units, will, together with certain related exchangeable securities, be exchanged on a one-for-one basis for newly issued shares of Brookfield Renewable Partners Inc. (“BEP Inc.”).

Shareholders of Brookfield Renewable Corporation (“BEPC”) have already approved the Simplification, pursuant to which their class A exchangeable subordinate voting shares will be exchanged for new shares of BEP Inc. on a one-for-one basis.

Benefits of a Simplified Structure

Brookfield Renewable expects the Simplification to be tax-deferred for Canadian and U.S. investors and completed without any meaningful cost to the business, while providing securityholders with the following benefits, among others:

  • Improved consolidated trading liquidity through a single listed security;
  • Increased demand from current indices and potential additional index inclusion;
  • Stronger alignment with long-term capital allocation trends toward indexable and ETF-eligible corporate securities;
  • Simplified investor analysis, screening, and benchmarking through a single listed reporting entity;
  • Broader access to a larger pool of investors who prefer corporate structures;
  • Enhanced governance framework and voting rights for public securityholders; and
  • For BEP unitholders, elimination of onerous partnership tax reporting forms and preferential dividend tax rates for many Canadian and U.S. taxable investors.

The Simplification will be implemented by way of a court-approved plan of arrangement and will be subject to customary regulatory approvals for a transaction of this nature, including approval for the listing of BEP Inc.’s shares on the New York Stock Exchange and Toronto Stock Exchange.

There will be no change to Brookfield’s ownership of Brookfield Renewable as a result of the Simplification. BEP’s preferred units and public debt will remain outstanding and unaffected by the Simplification.

The Board of Directors of BEP, based in part on the unanimous recommendation of its nominating and governance committee (consisting entirely of independent directors) and the fairness opinion previously received from Scotiabank, unanimously affirmed the conclusion that the Simplification, as amended, is in the best interests of BEP, and have unanimously resolved to approve the Simplification and recommend that BEP unitholders vote in favour of the Simplification.

Torys LLP is acting as legal advisor to Brookfield Renewable for the Simplification.

Scotiabank is acting as independent financial advisor, and Goodmans LLP is acting as independent legal counsel to the nominating and governance committees of each of BEP and BEPC in connection with the Simplification.

Further information regarding the Simplification, including details on the vote that will be required, will be contained in a disclosure supplement that will be available later today. ZUG, Switzerland--(BUSINESS WIRE)--vVARDIS (NYSE: VVVV), the Swiss healthcare company in the dental med-tech sector offering non-invasive treatment for early-stage cavities, and Henry Schein One, a global leader in dental technology, today announced the launch of clinical auto-charting functionality for clinicians documenting early-stage cavities.

When a clinician detects an early-stage cavity, auto-charting features in Dentrix and Ascend record the code in the patient's chart with one click, reducing the charting process by 86%. The care team can then choose Curodont® to treat the tooth during the same visit, without duplicate documentation and with access to patient education resources regarding Curodont® within the platform. The launch will represent the next phase of the collaboration between vVARDIS and Henry Schein One, which earlier this year introduced in-software awareness of Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus to practices that use Dentrix and Ascend across the United States.

Tooth decay is the world’s most prevalent non-communicable disease, affecting approximately 2.5 billion people globally.1 A recent population-based cohort study in the U.S. associates untreated cavities with a 26 percent increased risk of all-cause mortality and a 48 percent increase in heart-disease mortality.2 Curodont® is designed as a non-invasive treatment intended to arrest or reverse early-stage cavities without drilling. "Finding an early cavity and treating it should be one workflow, not two," said Haley Abivardi, DMD, co-CEO and co-founder of vVARDIS. “Dental teams want accurate information about their options for early-stage cavities, and patients want to understand the treatment they receive. "Our vision for Dentrix and Ascend is to bring intelligence directly into the clinical workflow, supporting clinicians without adding complexity. Auto-charting for the treatment of early-stage cavities is a great example of how we are connecting clinical insights, AI imaging, and documentation in a one click workflow to make technology work more simply for the dental team,” said April Lowry, Executive Director and General Manager, Clinical and AI, Henry Schein One.

This partnership promises to streamline access to drill-free dental solutions for patients across the United States.

Key Terms

non-communicable diseasemedical
Non-communicable diseases are health conditions that are not passed between people, typically developing slowly and lasting a long time—think chronic wear-and-tear illnesses like heart disease, diabetes, and most cancers rather than a contagious cold. They matter to investors because they drive sustained demand for drugs, medical devices, long-term care and insurance, influence healthcare costs and policy, and can create predictable revenue opportunities or risks across healthcare and consumer sectors.
all-cause mortalitymedical
All-cause mortality is the total number of deaths from any cause within a defined group over a specific time period. For investors, it is a broad safety and outcome measure used in clinical trials and public-health studies—like counting everyone who leaves a club for any reason—because higher or lower all-cause mortality can influence regulatory decisions, product reputation, long-term liability and market value.
cohort studymedical
A cohort study follows a specific group of people who share a common trait (like exposure to a drug or treatment) over time to see how many develop a particular outcome, such as a health effect. For investors, cohort studies matter because they provide real-world evidence about a product’s safety, effectiveness or market need—think of tracking a cohort like watching a neighborhood over years to see who adopts a new service and whether it works as promised.
randomized controlled trialsmedical
Randomized controlled trials are studies where participants are randomly assigned to receive either a new treatment or a comparison (such as a standard treatment or placebo), so outcomes can be fairly compared like flipping a coin to decide teams. For investors, they matter because they provide the most reliable evidence about whether a drug, device or intervention actually works and is safe, which influences regulatory approval, market demand and the financial outlook of companies developing them.
meta-analysesmedical
A meta-analysis is a research method that combines and statistically pools the results of multiple independent studies that address the same question, producing a single summary estimate of effect (for example, treatment benefit or risk). It increases precision by weighting studies according to size and variance, but its conclusions depend on the quality and compatibility of the included studies and can be distorted by differences between studies (heterogeneity) or by publication and selection biases.
